verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents an On-premise, self-hosted edition for organizations that want to manage their own data, run inside their own PCI- or HIPAA-compliant environments. That lets customers control where data is stored, but only by self-hosting; nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection for the hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: selectable data regions (e.g., US/EU) for hosted BugSnag, documented residency guarantees, independent corroboration.
